openings.claim: If rim geometry permits, rim-anchored paired-strip clamps with outboard connecting bolt shanks against opposing hatch edges along the pull could carry lateral load by bearing while modest pressure retains the hatch. Drill only supplied strips; rubber-pad clamp contacts, alternate tightening, tether removable assemblies/pads outside the aperture; never remedy poor location with corner pressure.
openings.discriminator: Against G0049:R1 with bolt clearance and friction-only restraint, comparable modest pressure should allow bearing stops to hold within 1 mm under 20 N despite the final right-contact card; friction alone may slide. Bearing should reduce need for pressure producing opposite-corner lift. Unestablished predictions; similar performance does not distinguish mechanisms.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, reject unless bolt shanks can contact hatch edges and capture the rim within supplied strip lengths without obstructing opening or touching seal. Within 90 fabrication minutes prepare identical assemblies for two configurations. Within 20 observation minutes: friction rival two closure/pull trials, one disturbed; candidate ten numbered opening/closure/pull cycles, final disturbed with right-contact 1 mm card. Record position before/after each 20 N pull, corner lift, reopening time, visible seal tears. Require final reopening within 30 seconds. Reject damage, permanent deformation, displacement beyond 1 mm or excessive release time.
openings.uncertainty: Rim access, bolt clearance, recoverable cord routing unknown; no extra parts. Supplied strips/six bolts must locate stops within 1 mm without bending, rim slip or permanent edge indentation. Four pads protect clamp contacts; exposed bearing may be infeasible. Fabrication, switching or measurement exceeding supplied time defeats comparison.

lineage.reason: Geometry-dependent bearing relation, complete friction comparison, probe, uncertainty and declared uncertain fit retained.

decision: Conditional probe only; twelve trials support a bounded comparison, not demonstrated improvement or deployment. Preserve hatch/rim/seal: no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; full marked opening clear when open, no powered mechanism, loose parts recoverable, no new visible seal tears. Disturbed closure waives only seal-contact continuity.
